'''Moenia''' was a [[city]] on [[Naboo]] whose level of activity was comparable to that of [[Theed]], the [[planet]]'s [[capital]]. [[Galactic Emperor|Emperor]] [[Darth Sidious|Palpatine]] had a [[Emperor's Retreat|retreat]] located west of Moenia.<ref name="GEG" />
